Program overview

Business foundations with focused expertise

Study the foundations of finance alongside the technologies and service models changing banking, payments, investment and financial decision-making. The specialization connects focused study with broader management knowledge and practical work, helping students apply what they learn to realistic organizational questions.

01

Corporate finance and financial analysis

02

Banking and digital financial services

03

Investment and risk fundamentals

04

FinTech products and business models

180 ECTS from foundations to application

The structure combines management study, focused specialization, learning across disciplines and professional practice.

Professional direction

Apply your learning to current business challenges

Students connect academic study with an internship or applied project. Working professionals may address a relevant challenge within their organization where appropriate.

  • FinTech business development
